mapper.select: SELECT t.teacher_id FROM teachers t JOIN users u ON t.teacher_id = u.login_id WHERE t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND u.role = 'TEACHER'

SELECT s.student_number AS studentNumber, s.name, s.total_point AS totalPoint FROM students s JOIN teachers t ON s.grade = t.grade AND s.class_name = t.class_name WHERE t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY s.student_number
